26	/**
27	 * @title Legion Sealed Bid Auction
28	 * @author Legion
29	 * @notice Executes sealed bid auctions of ERC20 tokens after Token Generation Event (TGE).
30	 * @dev Inherits from LegionAbstractSale and implements ILegionSealedBidAuctionSale with ECIES encryption features for
31	 * bid privacy.
32	 */
33	contract LegionSealedBidAuctionSale is LegionAbstractSale, ILegionSealedBidAuctionSale {
34	    /// @dev Struct containing the sealed bid auction sale configuration
35	    SealedBidAuctionSaleConfiguration private s_sealedBidAuctionSaleConfig;
36	
37	    /// @notice Restricts interaction to when the sale cancelation is locked.
38	    /// @dev Reverts if canceling is not locked.
39	    modifier whenCancelLocked() {
40	        // Verify that canceling is locked
41	        _verifyCancelLocked();
42	        _;
43	    }
44	
45	    /// @notice Restricts interaction to when the sale cancelation is not locked.
46	    /// @dev Reverts if canceling is locked.
47	    modifier whenCancelNotLocked() {
48	        // Verify that canceling is not locked
49	        _verifyCancelNotLocked();
50	        _;
51	    }
52	
53	    /// @inheritdoc ILegionSealedBidAuctionSale
54	    function initialize(
55	        LegionSaleInitializationParams calldata saleInitParams,
56	        SealedBidAuctionSaleInitializationParams calldata sealedBidAuctionSaleInitParams
57	    )
58	        external
59	        initializer
60	    {
61	        // Verify if the sale initialization parameters are valid
62	        _verifyValidParams(sealedBidAuctionSaleInitParams);
63	
64	        // Initialize and set the sale common parameters
65	        _setLegionSaleConfig(saleInitParams);
66	
67	        // Set the sealed bid auction sale specific configuration
68	        (s_sealedBidAuctionSaleConfig.publicKey) = sealedBidAuctionSaleInitParams.publicKey;
69	
70	        // Calculate and set startTime, endTime and refundEndTime
71	        s_saleConfig.startTime = uint64(block.timestamp);
72	        s_saleConfig.endTime = s_saleConfig.startTime + saleInitParams.salePeriodSeconds;
73	        s_saleConfig.refundEndTime = s_saleConfig.endTime + saleInitParams.refundPeriodSeconds;
74	    }
75	
76	    /// @inheritdoc ILegionSealedBidAuctionSale
77	    function invest(
78	        uint256 amount,
79	        bytes calldata sealedBid,
80	        bytes calldata signature
81	    )
82	        external
83	        whenNotPaused
84	        whenSaleNotEnded
85	        whenSaleNotCanceled
86	    {
87	        // Check if the investor has already invested
88	        // If not, create a new investor position
89	        uint256 positionId = _getInvestorPositionId(msg.sender) == 0
90	            ? _createInvestorPosition(msg.sender)
91	            : s_investorPositionIds[msg.sender];
92	
93	        // Verify that the investor is allowed to invest capital
94	        _verifyInvestSignature(signature);
95	
96	        // Decode the sealed bid data
97	        (uint256 encryptedAmountOut, Point memory sealedBidPublicKey) = abi.decode(sealedBid, (uint256, Point));
98	
99	        // Verify that the provided public key is valid
100	        _verifyValidPublicKey(sealedBidPublicKey);
101	
102	        // Verify that the amount invested is more than the minimum required
103	        _verifyMinimumInvestAmount(amount);
104	
105	        // Verify that the investor has not refunded
106	        _verifyHasNotRefunded(positionId);
107	
108	        // Verify that the investor has not claimed excess capital
109	        _verifyHasNotClaimedExcess(positionId);
110	
111	        // Increment total capital invested from all investors
112	        s_saleStatus.totalCapitalInvested += amount;
113	
114	        // Increment total invested capital for the investor
115	        s_investorPositions[positionId].investedCapital += amount;
116	
117	        // Emit CapitalInvested event
118	        emit CapitalInvested(amount, encryptedAmountOut, msg.sender, positionId);
